hook: Your photo here would look like another planet.
title: Ethiopia's Acid Pools Look Like Mars
description:
The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia has yellow, green and red acid pools on a hot salt desert. The colours come from minerals and sulfur. Parts of it lie below sea level and it is one of the hottest places on Earth.

#Shorts #geography #Ethiopia
